#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Copy the local SharkSight database into a hosted Postgres (Neon, D-063). Run once from this Mac, before or after the
# Render service first starts:
#
#   deploy/render/load-data.sh '<owner connection string from Neon>'          # e.g. postgresql://neondb_owner:…/neondb?sslmode=require
#   deploy/render/load-data.sh '<url>' --replace                              # wipe the target's data first
#
# 1. schema: the Alembic migrations as the owner (creates pgvector, the tables, triggers and the `sharksight_app` role
#    with APP_DB_PASSWORD from the repo's .env — the same password goes into Render's DATABASE_URL);
# 2. data: a fresh `make backup` restored data-only in one transaction (no --disable-triggers: hosted Postgres gives no
#    superuser; the append-only triggers only block UPDATE/DELETE, so inserts pass).
# Needs the local database running (`make db`); pg_restore runs in a throwaway postgres container.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
URL="${1:-}"; [[ -n "$URL" ]] || { sed -n '2,13p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; exit 1; }
REPLACE=0; [[ "${2:-}" == "--replace" ]] && REPLACE=1
PG_IMAGE="pgvector/pgvector:0.8.0-pg17"
say() { printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m\n' "$*"; }
psql_url() { docker run --rm -i "$PG_IMAGE" psql "$URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -tA "$@"; }

APP_DB_PASSWORD="REDACTED"$ROOT/.env" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2-)"
[[ -n "$APP_DB_PASSWORD" ]] || { echo "error: APP_DB_PASSWORD missing in .env" >&2; exit 1; }

say "schema (migrations as the owner)…"
(cd "$ROOT/backend" && APP_DB_PASSWORD="REDACTED" uv run alembic -x "url=$URL" upgrade head)

rows="$(psql_url -c 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source_item' | tr -d '[:space:]')"
if [[ "$rows" != "0" ]]; then
  [[ $REPLACE == 1 ]] || { echo "error: the target already holds $rows source items — add --replace to wipe it" >&2; exit 1; }
  say "wiping the target's data…"
  # TRUNCATE is not UPDATE/DELETE, so the append-only triggers don't fire; the schema and the app role stay
  psql_url -c "DO \$\$ DECLARE t text; BEGIN SELECT string_agg(format('%I', tablename), ', ') INTO t FROM pg_tables
               WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename <> 'alembic_version';
               EXECUTE 'TRUNCATE ' || t || ' RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE'; END \$\$;"
fi

say "dumping the local database…"
make -C "$ROOT" backup >/dev/null
dump="$(ls -t "$ROOT"/data/backups/sharksight-*.dump | head -1)"
say "restoring $(basename "$dump") ($(du -h "$dump" | cut -f1)) — a few minutes over the internet…"
docker run --rm -i -v "$dump:/db.dump:ro" "$PG_IMAGE" sh -c \
  "pg_restore -l /db.dump | grep -v alembic_version > /tmp/list && \
   pg_restore -d '$URL' --data-only --no-owner --no-privileges --single-transaction -L /tmp/list /db.dump"
# sequences: restored values come with the data (SEQUENCE SET entries)
psql_url -c "SELECT 'source items: ' || COUNT(*) FROM source_item"
psql_url -c "SELECT 'database size: ' || pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database()))"
say "done"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Copy the local SharkSight database into a hosted Postgres (Neon, D-063). Run once from this Mac, before or after the
# Render service first starts:
#
#   deploy/render/load-data.sh '<owner connection string from Neon>'          # e.g. postgresql://neondb_owner:…/neondb?sslmode=require
#   deploy/render/load-data.sh '<url>' --replace                              # wipe the target's data first
#
# 1. schema: the Alembic migrations as the owner (creates pgvector, the tables, triggers and the `sharksight_app` role
#    with APP_DB_PASSWORD from the repo's .env — the same password goes into Render's DATABASE_URL);
# 2. data: a fresh `make backup` restored data-only in one transaction (no --disable-triggers: hosted Postgres gives no
#    superuser; the append-only triggers only block UPDATE/DELETE, so inserts pass).
# Needs the local database running (`make db`); pg_restore runs in a throwaway postgres container.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
URL="${1:-}"; [[ -n "$URL" ]] || { sed -n '2,13p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; exit 1; }
REPLACE=0; [[ "${2:-}" == "--replace" ]] && REPLACE=1
PG_IMAGE="pgvector/pgvector:0.8.0-pg17"
say() { printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m\n' "$*"; }
psql_url() { docker run --rm -i "$PG_IMAGE" psql "$URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -tA "$@"; }

APP_DB_PASSWORD="REDACTED"$ROOT/.env" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2-)"
[[ -n "$APP_DB_PASSWORD" ]] || { echo "error: APP_DB_PASSWORD missing in .env" >&2; exit 1; }

say "schema (migrations as the owner)…"
(cd "$ROOT/backend" && APP_DB_PASSWORD="REDACTED" uv run alembic -x "url=$URL" upgrade head)

rows="$(psql_url -c 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source_item' | tr -d '[:space:]')"
if [[ "$rows" != "0" ]]; then
  [[ $REPLACE == 1 ]] || { echo "error: the target already holds $rows source items — add --replace to wipe it" >&2; exit 1; }
  say "wiping the target's data…"
  # TRUNCATE is not UPDATE/DELETE, so the append-only triggers don't fire; the schema and the app role stay
  psql_url -c "DO \$\$ DECLARE t text; BEGIN SELECT string_agg(format('%I', tablename), ', ') INTO t FROM pg_tables
               WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename <> 'alembic_version';
               EXECUTE 'TRUNCATE ' || t || ' RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE'; END \$\$;"
fi

say "dumping the local database…"
make -C "$ROOT" backup >/dev/null
dump="$(ls -t "$ROOT"/data/backups/sharksight-*.dump | head -1)"
say "restoring $(basename "$dump") ($(du -h "$dump" | cut -f1)) — a few minutes over the internet…"
docker run --rm -i -v "$dump:/db.dump:ro" "$PG_IMAGE" sh -c \
  "pg_restore -l /db.dump | grep -v alembic_version > /tmp/list && \
   pg_restore -d '$URL' --data-only --no-owner --no-privileges --single-transaction -L /tmp/list /db.dump"
# sequences: restored values come with the data (SEQUENCE SET entries)
psql_url -c "SELECT 'source items: ' || COUNT(*) FROM source_item"
psql_url -c "SELECT 'database size: ' || pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database()))"
say "done"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Copy the local SharkSight database into a hosted Postgres (Neon, D-063). Run once from this Mac, BEFORE the Render
# service first starts (or restart it afterwards):
#
#   deploy/render/load-data.sh '<owner connection string from Neon>'     # postgresql://neondb_owner:…/neondb?sslmode=require
#   deploy/render/load-data.sh '<url>' --replace                         # drop everything in the target first
#
# 1. a fresh `make backup`, restored in full (schema, data, then keys / indexes / triggers — in that order, so foreign
#    keys never see half-loaded tables; hosted Postgres has no superuser for --disable-triggers);
# 2. the app role `sharksight_app` + its grants (migrations/sql/0003_app_role.sql) with APP_DB_PASSWORD from the repo's
#    .env — use the same password in Render's DATABASE_URL. The restored alembic_version says the schema is current,
#    so the app's migrations on start have nothing to do.
# Needs the local database running (`make db`); psql / pg_restore run in a throwaway postgres container.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
URL="${1:-}"; [[ -n "$URL" ]] || { sed -n '2,15p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; exit 1; }
REPLACE=0; [[ "${2:-}" == "--replace" ]] && REPLACE=1
URL="${CONTAINER_URL:-$URL}"   # only for tests against local Postgres: the URL as seen from a container
PG_IMAGE="pgvector/pgvector:0.8.0-pg17"
say() { printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m\n' "$*"; }
psql_url() { docker run --rm -i "$PG_IMAGE" psql "$URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -qtA "$@"; }

APP_DB_PASSWORD="REDACTED"$ROOT/.env" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2-)"
[[ -n "$APP_DB_PASSWORD" ]] || { echo "error: APP_DB_PASSWORD missing in .env" >&2; exit 1; }

tables="$(psql_url -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public'" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
if [[ "$tables" != "0" ]]; then
  [[ $REPLACE == 1 ]] || { echo "error: the target already has $tables tables — add --replace to drop them" >&2; exit 1; }
  say "dropping everything in the target's public schema…"
  psql_url -c "DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;"
fi

say "dumping the local database…"
make -C "$ROOT" backup >/dev/null
dump="$(ls -t "$ROOT"/data/backups/sharksight-*.dump | head -1)"
say "restoring $(basename "$dump") ($(du -h "$dump" | cut -f1)) — a few minutes over the internet…"
# --no-owner / --no-privileges: the target's owner owns everything, grants come from 0003 below. The schema-level
# entries (public schema, extension comment) belong to the target already and are left out.
docker run --rm -i -v "$dump:/db.dump:ro" "$PG_IMAGE" sh -c \
  "pg_restore -l /db.dump | grep -v -E ' SCHEMA - public | COMMENT - EXTENSION ' > /tmp/list && \
   pg_restore -d '$URL' --no-owner --no-privileges --single-transaction --exit-on-error -L /tmp/list /db.dump"

say "app role and grants…"
{ cat "$ROOT/backend/migrations/sql/0003_app_role.sql"
  echo "\\set pw '$APP_DB_PASSWORD'"
  echo "ALTER ROLE sharksight_app LOGIN PASSWORD :'pw';"; } | psql_url
psql_url -c "SELECT 'source items: ' || COUNT(*) FROM source_item"
psql_url -c "SELECT 'database size: ' || pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database()))"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Copy the local SharkSight database into a hosted Postgres (Neon, D-063). Run once from this Mac, BEFORE the Render
# service first starts (or restart it afterwards):
#
#   deploy/render/load-data.sh '<owner connection string from Neon>'     # postgresql://neondb_owner:…/neondb?sslmode=require
#   deploy/render/load-data.sh '<url>' --replace                         # drop everything in the target first
#
# 1. a fresh `make backup`, restored in full (schema, data, then keys / indexes / triggers — in that order, so foreign
#    keys never see half-loaded tables; hosted Postgres has no superuser for --disable-triggers);
# 2. the app role `sharksight_app` + its grants (migrations/sql/0003_app_role.sql) with APP_DB_PASSWORD from the repo's
#    .env — use the same password in Render's DATABASE_URL. The restored alembic_version says the schema is current,
#    so the app's migrations on start have nothing to do.
# Needs the local database running (`make db`); psql / pg_restore run in a throwaway postgres container.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
URL="${1:-}"; [[ -n "$URL" ]] || { sed -n '2,15p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; exit 1; }
REPLACE=0; [[ "${2:-}" == "--replace" ]] && REPLACE=1
URL="${CONTAINER_URL:-$URL}"   # only for tests against local Postgres: the URL as seen from a container
PG_IMAGE="pgvector/pgvector:0.8.0-pg17"
say() { printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m\n' "$*"; }
psql_url() { docker run --rm -i "$PG_IMAGE" psql "$URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -qtA "$@"; }

APP_DB_PASSWORD="REDACTED"$ROOT/.env" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2-)"
[[ -n "$APP_DB_PASSWORD" ]] || { echo "error: APP_DB_PASSWORD missing in .env" >&2; exit 1; }

tables="$(psql_url -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public'" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
if [[ "$tables" != "0" ]]; then
  [[ $REPLACE == 1 ]] || { echo "error: the target already has $tables tables — add --replace to drop them" >&2; exit 1; }
  say "dropping everything in the target's public schema…"
  psql_url -c "DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;"
fi

say "dumping the local database…"
make -C "$ROOT" backup >/dev/null
dump="$(ls -t "$ROOT"/data/backups/sharksight-*.dump | head -1)"
say "restoring $(basename "$dump") ($(du -h "$dump" | cut -f1)) — a few minutes over the internet…"
# --no-owner / --no-privileges: the target's owner owns everything, grants come from 0003 below. The schema-level
# entries (public schema, extension comment) belong to the target already and are left out.
docker run --rm -i -v "$dump:/db.dump:ro" "$PG_IMAGE" sh -c \
  "pg_restore -l /db.dump | grep -v -E ' SCHEMA - public | COMMENT - EXTENSION ' > /tmp/list && \
   pg_restore -d '$URL' --no-owner --no-privileges --single-transaction --exit-on-error -L /tmp/list /db.dump"

say "app role and grants…"
{ cat "$ROOT/backend/migrations/sql/0003_app_role.sql"
  echo "\\set pw '$APP_DB_PASSWORD'"
  echo "ALTER ROLE sharksight_app LOGIN PASSWORD :'pw';"; } | psql_url
psql_url -c "SELECT 'source items: ' || COUNT(*) FROM source_item"
psql_url -c "SELECT 'database size: ' || pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database()))"
say "done"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Copy the local SharkSight database into a hosted Postgres (Neon, D-063). Run once from this Mac, before or after the
# Render service first starts:
#
#   deploy/render/load-data.sh '<owner connection string from Neon>'          # e.g. postgresql://neondb_owner:…/neondb?sslmode=require
#   deploy/render/load-data.sh '<url>' --replace                              # wipe the target's data first
#
# 1. schema: the Alembic migrations as the owner (creates pgvector, the tables, triggers and the `sharksight_app` role
#    with APP_DB_PASSWORD from the repo's .env — the same password goes into Render's DATABASE_URL);
# 2. data: a fresh `make backup` restored data-only in one transaction (no --disable-triggers: hosted Postgres gives no
#    superuser; the append-only triggers only block UPDATE/DELETE, so inserts pass).
# Needs the local database running (`make db`); pg_restore runs in a throwaway postgres container.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
URL="${1:-}"; [[ -n "$URL" ]] || { sed -n '2,13p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; exit 1; }
REPLACE=0; [[ "${2:-}" == "--replace" ]] && REPLACE=1
PG_IMAGE="pgvector/pgvector:0.8.0-pg17"
CURL="${CONTAINER_URL:-$URL}"   # the same URL as seen from a container (only differs when testing against local Postgres)
say() { printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m\n' "$*"; }
psql_url() { docker run --rm -i "$PG_IMAGE" psql "$CURL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -tA "$@"; }

APP_DB_PASSWORD="REDACTED"$ROOT/.env" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2-)"
[[ -n "$APP_DB_PASSWORD" ]] || { echo "error: APP_DB_PASSWORD missing in .env" >&2; exit 1; }

say "schema (migrations as the owner)…"
(cd "$ROOT/backend" && APP_DB_PASSWORD="REDACTED" uv run alembic -x "url=$URL" upgrade head)

rows="$(psql_url -c 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source_item' | tr -d '[:space:]')"
if [[ "$rows" != "0" ]]; then
  [[ $REPLACE == 1 ]] || { echo "error: the target already holds $rows source items — add --replace to wipe it" >&2; exit 1; }
  say "wiping the target's data…"
  # TRUNCATE is not UPDATE/DELETE, so the append-only triggers don't fire; the schema and the app role stay
  psql_url -c "DO \$\$ DECLARE t text; BEGIN SELECT string_agg(format('%I', tablename), ', ') INTO t FROM pg_tables
               WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename <> 'alembic_version';
               EXECUTE 'TRUNCATE ' || t || ' RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE'; END \$\$;"
fi

say "dumping the local database…"
make -C "$ROOT" backup >/dev/null
dump="$(ls -t "$ROOT"/data/backups/sharksight-*.dump | head -1)"
say "restoring $(basename "$dump") ($(du -h "$dump" | cut -f1)) — a few minutes over the internet…"
docker run --rm -i -v "$dump:/db.dump:ro" "$PG_IMAGE" sh -c \
  "pg_restore -l /db.dump | grep -v alembic_version > /tmp/list && \
   pg_restore -d '$CURL' --data-only --no-owner --no-privileges --single-transaction -L /tmp/list /db.dump"
# sequences: restored values come with the data (SEQUENCE SET entries)
psql_url -c "SELECT 'source items: ' || COUNT(*) FROM source_item"
psql_url -c "SELECT 'database size: ' || pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database()))"
say "done"

* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported and will return an error - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels. Requires a Claude in Chrome extension version that supports scale; older extensions return the full-size image.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

tabId.description: Tab ID to execute the action on. Must be a tab in the current group. Use tabs_context_mcp first if you don't have a valid tab ID.

save_to_disk.description: For screenshot/zoom actions: save the image to disk so it can be attached to a message for the user. Returns the saved path in the tool result. Only set this when you intend to share the image — screenshots you're just looking at don't need saving.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

entries.name: mcp__claude-in-chrome__find
entries.description: Find elements on the page using natural language. Can search for elements by their purpose (e.g., "search bar", "login button") or by text content (e.g., "organic mango product"). Returns up to 20 matching elements with references that can be used with other tools. If more than 20 matches exist, you'll be notified to use a more specific query. If you don't have a valid tab ID, use tabs_context_mcp first to get available tabs.

query.description: Natural language description of what to find (e.g., "search bar", "add to cart button", "product title containing organic")

tabId.description: Tab ID to search in. Must be a tab in the current group. Use tabs_context_mcp first if you don't have a valid tab ID.

entries.name: mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate
entries.description: Navigate to a URL, or go forward/back in browser history. tabId may be omitted for URL navigation when calling navigate STANDALONE (not inside browser_batch): tabs_context_mcp{createIfEmpty:true} is called for you and the first tab in the session's group is navigated — its result is appended to this call's output so you have the tab list and ids for subsequent calls. Inside browser_batch, navigate (and other tools that act on a page) requires an explicit tabId. Pass an explicit tabId when you need a specific tab or when the session's group has multiple tabs whose state you must preserve. tabId is required for url:"back"/"forward". A tab opened for you this way is yours to clean up, the same as one from tabs_create_mcp: close it with tabs_close_mcp once you no longer need it and before finishing your task, unless the user asked to see it or wants it kept open.

url.description: The URL to navigate to. Can be provided with or without protocol (defaults to https://). Use "forward" to go forward in history or "back" to go back in history.

tabId.description: Tab ID to navigate. Must be a tab in the current group. If omitted for URL navigation when calling navigate standalone, tabs_context_mcp{createIfEmpty:true} is called for you. Required for url:"back"/"forward" and for navigate (and other tools that act on a page) inside browser_batch.

entries.name: mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_console_messages
entries.description: Read browser console messages (console.log, console.error, console.warn, etc.) from a specific tab. Useful for debugging JavaScript errors, viewing application logs, or understanding what's happening in the browser console. Returns console messages from the current domain only. If you don't have a valid tab ID, use tabs_context_mcp first to get available tabs. IMPORTANT: Always provide a pattern to filter messages - without a pattern, you may get too many irrelevant messages.

tabId.description: Tab ID to read console messages from. Must be a tab in the current group. Use tabs_context_mcp first if you don't have a valid tab ID.

onlyErrors.description: If true, only return error and exception messages. Default is false (return all message types).

clear.description: If true, clear the console messages after reading to avoid duplicates on subsequent calls. Default is false.

pattern.description: Regex pattern to filter console messages. Only messages matching this pattern will be returned (e.g., 'error|warning' to find errors and warnings, 'MyApp' to filter app-specific logs). You should always provide a pattern to avoid getting too many irrelevant messages.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return. Defaults to 100. Increase only if you need more results.

entries.name: mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp
entries.description: Get context information about the current MCP tab group. Returns all tab IDs inside the group if it exists. CRITICAL: You must get the context at least once before using other browser automation tools so you know what tabs exist. Each new conversation should create its own new tab (using tabs_create_mcp) rather than reusing existing tabs, unless the user explicitly asks to use an existing tab.

createIfEmpty.description: Creates a new MCP tab group if none exists, creates a new Window with a new tab group containing an empty tab (which can be used for this conversation). If a MCP tab group already exists, this parameter has no effect.

entries.name: mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp
entries.description: Creates a new empty tab in the MCP tab group. CRITICAL: You must get the context using tabs_context_mcp at least once before using other browser automation tools so you know what tabs exist. Tabs you create are yours to clean up: close each one with tabs_close_mcp as soon as you no longer need it, and close any that remain before finishing your task. Leave a tab open only if the user asked to see it or wants it kept open.

# Render Blueprint (D-063): the SharkSight app as one free Docker web service; the database is Neon (hosted Postgres).
# Render builds the repo's Dockerfile (target prod: API + built PM app + the CC BY car models). The service's disk is
# not kept, so the app's own settings changes (limits, agent settings on the AI agents page) reset on every restart;
# the OpenAI key comes from OPENAI_API_KEY. Guide: deploy/README.md.
services:
  - type: web
    name: sharksight
    runtime: docker
    plan: free
    region: frankfurt                # same region as the Neon project (AWS eu-central-1)
    dockerfilePath: ./Dockerfile
    dockerContext: .
    healthCheckPath: /api/health     # the only path open without the access key
    autoDeploy: true
    envVars:
      - key: APP_ENV
        value: production
      - key: API_PORT
        value: "10000"               # Render's default port
      - key: ACCESS_KEY              # the one password for the browser (any user name)
        sync: false
      - key: DATABASE_URL            # the app role — printed by deploy/render/load-data.sh
        sync: false
      - key: MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL  # Neon's owner connection string (migrations on start)
        sync: false
      - key: OPENAI_API_KEY
        sync: false

# Deploying SharkSight: Render + Neon (D-063)

The app runs as one free **Render** web service built from the repo's `Dockerfile` (`render.yaml`); the database is a
free **Neon** Postgres (pgvector) in Frankfurt. One shared **access key** guards everything (`api/access.py`): the
browser asks once (any user name, the key as password). No user accounts.

```
render.yaml                  the Render service (Docker, free plan, Frankfurt, env vars)
deploy/render/load-data.sh   copy the local database into Neon (once) and print the app's DATABASE_URL
assets/models/               the compressed CC BY car models, baked into the image
```

## Cost and limits (free plans)

- **Render free:** 512 MB RAM (the app uses ~100 MB). Sleeps after 15 min without traffic; the first request then
  takes about a minute. No disk: settings changed in the app (spend limits, agent settings) reset on restart; the
  OpenAI key comes from `OPENAI_API_KEY`.
- **Neon free:** 0.5 GB storage; the database is ~440 MB after a fresh restore — enough for the app's few writes
  (decisions, audit events, AI usage), not for re-running whole pipeline stages in the cloud (run those locally).

## Setup (once)

1. **Neon:** create a project in **AWS Europe Central 1 (Frankfurt)**, Postgres 17; database `neondb` is fine. Copy
   the **owner** connection string (Dashboard → Connect, *not* the pooled one).
2. **Load the data** from this Mac (local database running, `make db`):
   ```bash
   deploy/render/load-data.sh 'REDACTED'
   ```
   It restores a fresh backup, creates the app role and prints the `DATABASE_URL` for Render.
3. **Render:** New → Blueprint → this repo. Fill in the four secrets it asks for:
   `ACCESS_KEY` (choose a long one), `DATABASE_URL` (from step 2), `MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL` (the owner string) and
   `OPENAI_API_KEY`. Render builds and starts it at `https://sharksight-….onrender.com`.

After a code change: push to `main` (auto-deploy). After new local data: `load-data.sh '<owner url>' --replace`, then
restart the service.

## Notes

- Only `/api/health` is open (Render's health check); everything else needs the key.
- The app connects as `sharksight_app` (no UPDATE / DELETE on the append-only tables); the owner string is only used
  for migrations on start.
- Before more people use it: real logins (the key is shared, `X-Actor` is self-declared) and app settings in the
  database instead of `data/settings.json`.

# Deploying SharkSight to Google Cloud (D-062)

One Compute Engine VM runs the same containers as your laptop: **db** (PostgreSQL 17 + pgvector), **app** (API + the
built PM app) and a small **proxy** (Caddy: HTTPS + one password, because the app has no login of its own yet).

```
deploy/compose.yaml   the stack on the VM (provider-neutral)
deploy/Caddyfile      HTTPS for <ip>.sslip.io + basic auth in front of the app
deploy/gcp/deploy.sh  the CLI: create the VM, ship the image and files, start, copy data, tunnel, destroy
```

## Cost

Made for the **Google Cloud free tier**: one e2-micro VM (2 shared vCPUs, 1 GB RAM) and 30 GB of standard disk are
free every month in `us-west1`, `us-central1` or `us-east1`, plus 1 GB of outbound traffic. A public IPv4 address may
be billed (a few dollars a month). New accounts also get a **$300 / 90-day trial credit**; as long as you don't
upgrade to a paid account, nothing is charged when it runs out. `deploy.sh budget` adds a $5 monthly alert.

1 GB is tight for Postgres + the app: the VM gets 2 GB of swap and Postgres is tuned small. If it is too slow,
`MACHINE_TYPE=e2-small` (2 GB, ≈ $12 / month, from the trial credit) — `destroy`, then `create` with it.

## One-time setup (you)

1. Create a Google Cloud account at https://console.cloud.google.com (card needed for verification; trial credit).
2. Create a project (e.g. `sharksight`) and make sure billing is linked to it.
3. On this Mac: `brew install --cask google-cloud-sdk`, then `gcloud auth login` and
   `gcloud config set project <project-id>`.
4. `deploy/gcp/deploy.sh check` (also switches on the Compute Engine API)

## Deploy

```bash
deploy/gcp/deploy.sh create          # SSH key, network + firewall, e2-micro (Ubuntu 24.04); wait ~2 min for Docker
deploy/gcp/deploy.sh deploy          # build the x86 image, send it + compose + .env + settings + 3D models, start
deploy/gcp/deploy.sh data            # copy your local database into the VM (once; --replace to overwrite)
deploy/gcp/deploy.sh url             # https://<ip>.sslip.io — user pm, password in deploy/gcp/.env.vm
deploy/gcp/deploy.sh budget
```

After a code change: `deploy/gcp/deploy.sh deploy` again (data stays; the app migrates the schema on start).

## Day to day

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `status`, `logs`, `ssh` | container state, last 200 log lines, a shell on the VM |
| `tunnel` | app on http://127.0.0.1:8601 and the VM's Postgres on 127.0.0.1:5434 — e.g. run a pipeline stage from this Mac against the cloud database with `DATABASE_URL=REDACTED` |
| `up --private` | db + app only, no public proxy; use `tunnel` to reach it |
| `allow-my-ip` | your IP changed and SSH is refused |
| `stop` / `start` | pause the VM (disk and data stay; the public IP changes → `push` then `up`) |
| `destroy` | delete the VM and its disk (all cloud data), firewall rules, network and SSH key |

Settings: `GCP_PROJECT` (default: gcloud's current project), `GCP_ZONE` (`us-central1-a`), `MACHINE_TYPE` (`e2-micro`).

## What is where

- Secrets: `deploy/gcp/.env.vm` (generated from your `.env`: OpenAI key, database passwords, the web login) and the SSH
  key `deploy/gcp/sharksight.key` — both git-ignored, 0600. On the VM they are `~sharksight/sharksight/.env`.
- Ports: the VM has its own network `sharksight` (not the default one, which allows SSH from anywhere): only 80/443
  (proxy) are open to the world, SSH only from your IP; the app (8600) and Postgres (5432) listen on the VM's localhost.
- The image is built for linux/amd64; on an ARM Mac the Python part is emulated (the frontend builds natively).

## Before anyone else uses it

The proxy password is shared, so the audit trail still records whatever name the browser sends (`X-Actor`). Real
logins for people, app settings in the database instead of `data/settings.json`, and the 3D models in object storage
are the next steps for a proper deployment (STATE → Next up).

Repo Render'a hazır. Sadece henüz commit edip push etmedim; Render repodaki `render.yaml`'ı ancak push'tan sonra görür. Yerelde uçtan uca test ettim, 136 testin hepsi geçti.

**Neon'daki sorular:**
- **Veritabanı adı `neondb`:** öyle kalabilir, kodda veritabanı adı geçmiyor. Bölge olarak **AWS Europe Central 1 (Frankfurt)** seç, Render da Frankfurt'ta olacak.
- **Object storage, Functions, AI Gateway, Neon Auth:** hiçbirine gerek yok, hepsini kapalı bırak. Object storage'ı açtıysan silebilirsin.
  - Auth yerine söylediğin basit anahtarı yaptım.
  - OpenAI'ye zaten bütçe korumalı kendi kodumuzla bağlanıyoruz, AI Gateway gereksiz.
  - Modelleri imajın içine koydum, bu yüzden object storage da gerekmiyor.

**Anahtar nasıl çalışıyor:** Render'da `ACCESS_KEY` diye bir şifre tanımlıyorsun. Siteyi açınca tarayıcı bir kez kullanıcı adı ve şifre soruyor; kullanıcı adı ne olursa olur, şifre bu anahtar. Kontrolü backend yapıyor, bu yüzden anahtar olmadan API'ye ve modellere de erişilemiyor. Veritabanında ayrıca bir şey tutmaya gerek kalmadı, çünkü veritabanının kendi şifresi zaten var ve onu yalnızca backend biliyor. Yerelde `ACCESS_KEY` tanımlı değilken hiçbir şey değişmiyor.

**Neler eklendi:**
- **`render.yaml`:** Render repoyu seçtiğinde bu dosyayı okuyor, Dockerfile'dan derleyip ücretsiz planda Frankfurt'ta çalıştırıyor.
- **`deploy/render/load-data.sh`:** Yerel veritabanını Neon'a kopyalıyor ve sonunda Render'a yapıştıracağın `DATABASE_URL`'i yazdırıyor. Haklıydın, embedding'lerin hepsi gidiyor; taze restore'da veritabanı 440 MB tutuyor.
- **3D modeller:** 74 MB'tan 8 MB'a sıkıştırıp `assets/models/` altında imaja koydum. Üçgen sayıları aynı kaldı; tarayıcıda kontrol ettim, araba düzgün görünüyor. Bunlar yazarına atıf verildiği sürece paylaşılabilen CC BY modeller; atıflar `assets/models/README.md`'de.
- **Doküman:** Kararı D-063 olarak yazdım ve `deploy/README.md`'yi güncelledim.

**Yerelde test ettiklerim:**
- Neon'u taklit eden, süper kullanıcı olmayan bir rolle yükleme çalıştı: 12.370 kayıt geldi.
- İlk denemede yabancı anahtar sırası yüzünden hata alındı, script'i buna göre düzelttim.
- Disk bağlanmamış imaj modelleri sunuyor; anahtarsız istek 401, anahtarlı istek 200 dönüyor.
- Denetim kaydı uygulama rolüyle değiştirilemiyor.

**Bilmen gerekenler:**
- Ücretsiz Render 15 dakika boşta kalınca uyuyor; ilk açılış yaklaşık bir dakika sürüyor.
- Disk olmadığı için uygulama içinden değiştirdiğin limitler ve agent ayarları her yeniden başlatmada varsayılana dönüyor.
- Neon'da yalnızca yaklaşık 60 MB boş yer kalıyor; pipeline adımlarını yerelde çalıştır.

**Senin yapacakların:**
1. **Neon:** projeyi Frankfurt'ta oluştur ve **owner** bağlantı adresini kopyala (pooled olanı değil).
2. **Veriyi yükle:** kendi terminalinde çalıştır (`make db` açık olmalı):
   ```
   deploy/render/load-data.sh 'REDACTED'
   ```
3. **Render:** New → Blueprint → `shark-sight` reposunu seç ve dört alanı doldur:
   - `ACCESS_KEY`: uzun bir şifre belirle.
   - `DATABASE_URL`: script'in yazdırdığı adres.
   - `MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL`: Neon'un owner adresi.
   - `OPENAI_API_KEY`: OpenAI anahtarın.

Karar vermen gereken iki şey var:
1. **Commit ve push edeyim mi?** 3. adımdan önce gerekiyor.
2. **Google Cloud dosyaları (`deploy/gcp/`) silinsin mi?** Az önce sormadan silmeye kalkıştım, güvenlik kontrolü durdurdu ve dosyalar yerinde. Şu an "kullanılmıyor" diye işaretli duruyorlar.

Sırayla gidelim. Her adımda ne göreceğini ve ne yapacağını yazdım. Bir yerde takılırsan ekranda gördüğünü veya hata mesajını buraya yapıştır.

## Adım 1: Neon'da veritabanını oluştur

1. Neon'da yeni bir proje oluştur:
   - **Project name:** `sharksight` (istediğin bir isim olabilir).
   - **Postgres version:** 17.
   - **Region:** **AWS Europe Central 1 (Frankfurt)**. Render da Frankfurt'ta, aynı bölgede olmaları uygulamayı hızlandırır.
   - **Database name:** `neondb` kalabilir.
   - **Auth, Object Storage, Functions, AI Gateway:** hepsi kapalı kalsın.
2. Proje açılınca **Connect** butonuna bas.
3. Açılan pencerede **Connection pooling** seçeneğini **kapat**. Pooled adreste `-pooler` geçer, onu istemiyoruz.
4. Rol olarak `neondb_owner`'ın seçili olduğundan emin ol.
5. Bağlantı adresini kopyala. Şuna benzer:
   ```
   REDACTED
   ```
   Bu, veritabanının ana şifresini içeriyor. Bir yere not al ama kimseyle paylaşma; bundan sonra ona **owner adresi** diyeceğim.

## Adım 2: Veriyi Mac'ten Neon'a yükle

1. Docker Desktop'ın açık olduğundan emin ol.
2. Terminalde proje klasörüne geç:
   ```
   cd ~/Documents/ehl-munich-final
   ```
3. Yerel veritabanını başlat:
   ```
   make db
   ```
4. Yükleme script'ini çalıştır. Owner adresini **tek tırnak** içinde yapıştır, çünkü adreste `&` var:
   ```
   deploy/render/load-data.sh 'BURAYA_OWNER_ADRESI'
   ```
5. Birkaç dakika bekle. Sırasıyla yerel yedeğin alındığını, Neon'a yüklendiğini ve uygulama rolünün kurulduğunu göreceksin. Sonunda şöyle bir çıktı gelir:
   ```
   source items: 12370
   database size: 440 MB
   done. Render → Environment:
     DATABASE_URL           = REDACTED
   ```
6. `DATABASE_URL =` satırındaki adresi kopyala. Bu da bir şifre içeriyor, onu da paylaşma.

Kaynak sayısı 12.370 değilse ya da hata alırsan, çıktıyı bana yapıştır ama içindeki şifreleri sil.

## Adım 3: Siteye girmek için bir anahtar belirle

Terminalde rastgele bir anahtar üret:
```
openssl rand -hex 24
```
Çıkan uzun metin senin `ACCESS_KEY`'in; siteye girerken bunu yazacaksın. Bir şifre yöneticisine kaydet.

## Adım 4: Render'da servisi kur

1. Render'a **GitHub hesabınla** giriş yap.
2. Render'ın GitHub'daki `shark-sight` reposunu görmesine izin ver. Bunu ya girişte sorar ya da GitHub ayarlarından "Render" uygulamasına bu repoyu eklersin.
3. Render panelinde **New → Blueprint**'i seç.
4. `atahankilc/shark-sight` reposunu ve `main` dalını seç. Render repodaki `render.yaml`'ı okur ve `sharksight` adında bir web servisi gösterir (Docker, Free plan, Frankfurt).
5. Senden dört değer ister:

   | Alan | Ne yazacaksın |
   |---|---|
   | `ACCESS_KEY` | 3. adımda ürettiğin anahtar |
   | `DATABASE_URL` | 2. adımda script'in yazdırdığı `sharksight_app` adresi |
   | `MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL` | 1. adımdaki owner adresi |
   | `OPENAI_API_KEY` | OpenAI anahtarın (`sk-...`) |

6. **Apply** (ya da **Deploy Blueprint**) butonuna bas.
7. Render imajı derlemeye başlar. İlk derleme yaklaşık 5–10 dakika sürer; servisin **Logs** sekmesinden izleyebilirsin. Sonda şuna benzer satırlar görmelisin:
   ```
   Application startup complete.
   Uvicorn running on http://0.0.0.0:10000
   ```
   Servisin durumu **Live** olunca hazır.

**Render kart isterse ya da Blueprint'e izin vermezse:** **New → Web Service** ile elle kur:
- Repo `shark-sight`, branch `main`.
- Language **Docker**, Region **Frankfurt**, Instance Type **Free**.
- Advanced → Health Check Path: `/api/health`.
- Environment Variables: yukarıdaki dört değerin yanına `APP_ENV` = `production` ve `API_PORT` = `10000` ekle.

## Adım 5: Siteyi aç

1. Render'ın verdiği adresi aç (`https://sharksight-xxxx.onrender.com`).
2. Tarayıcı kullanıcı adı ve şifre sorar:
   - **Kullanıcı adı:** ne yazdığının önemi yok, örneğin `pm`.
   - **Şifre:** `ACCESS_KEY`.
3. Uygulama açılmalı, Definition sayfasında 3D araba görünmeli.

## Sonra bilmen gerekenler

- **15 dakika kimse girmezse servis uyur.** Sonraki ilk açılış yaklaşık bir dakika sürer. Birine göstermeden önce siteyi bir kez aç.
- **Kodu değiştirip `main`'e push edince** Render otomatik olarak yeniden derler.
- **Yerelde yeni veri ürettiğinde** script'i `--replace` ile tekrar çalıştır, sonra Render'da servisi **Manual Deploy → Restart** ile yeniden başlat:
  ```
  deploy/render/load-data.sh 'OWNER_ADRESI' --replace
  ```
- **Uygulamada değiştirdiğin limitler ve agent ayarları** her yeniden başlatmada varsayılana döner. API anahtarı ise Render'daki ayardan geldiği için kaybolmaz.

İlk adımdan başla; her adım bitince ya da takılınca yaz.

content.text:
Teknik olarak olur. Kod anahtarın uzunluğuna bakmıyor; Render'da `ACCESS_KEY`'e `sharksight` yazarsın, README'ye de "şifre: sharksight" eklersin, hiçbir şeyi değiştirmem gerekmez. Ama kontrol ettim, repo **public**. Yani anahtarı README'ye yazmak uygulamayı tüm internete açmak demek. Karar senin; sadece neyi açtığını bilerek ver:

1. **Asıl risk BMW'nin verisi.** İçeride BMW'nin hackathon için verdiği 10.128 gizli müşteri yorumu, müşteri çalışması ve satış rakamları var. Buluta koymayı sen onayladın, ama bu herkese açmakla aynı şey değil. Veri senin değil BMW'nin, ve hackathon şartları büyük ihtimalle paylaşımı yasaklıyor. AGENTS kural 1'de de "gizli" yazıyor. Bence en riskli kısım bu.
2. **Herkes PM kararı verebilir.** Gezen biri gereksinimleri onaylayabilir, reddedebilir veya öncelik değiştirebilir. Denetim kaydı append-only olduğu için bunlar uygulama içinden silinemiyor; temizlemenin tek yolu veriyi `--replace` ile baştan yüklemek.
3. **API anahtarı paylaşılır.** OpenAI anahtarı koymazsan AI işleri zaten çalışmaz, orası doğru. Ama biri uygulamaya kendi anahtarını girerse, o anahtar sunucuda saklanıyor ve servis yeniden başlayana kadar **herkes** onunla iş çalıştırabiliyor.
4. **Veritabanı dolabilir.** Neon'da yaklaşık 60 MB boş yer var. Biri çok fazla yazı yazarsa veritabanı dolar ve uygulama durur.

**Önerim:** Basit bir anahtar kullan ama README'ye yazma. Göstermek istediğin kişilere linkle birlikte ayrıca söylersin. Böylece hatırlaması kolay olur, veri de herkese açılmaz.

Yine de herkese açık olsun istersen, kısa bir değişiklikle **salt okunur mod** ekleyebilirim. Ziyaretçiler her şeyi görür ama karar veremez, ayar değiştiremez, anahtar giremez. Bu 2, 3 ve 4. maddeleri çözer; 1. madde, yani BMW verisinin açılması, olduğu gibi kalır.

Hangisini istersin?
- Basit anahtar, README'de yazmasın (kod değişikliği yok).
- Herkese açık ve salt okunur (README'ye yazarız, ben salt okunur modu eklerim).

"""One shared access key for changes (cloud deployment, D-063): no user accounts, no login page.

If `ACCESS_KEY` is set, anyone can read (GET) but every request that changes something — PM decisions, weights,
settings, the OpenAI key, agent settings — must carry the key in `X-Access-Key`; without it the API does nothing
(403). The PM app's "Access" panel (bottom left) stores the key in the browser and sends it with every request.
`POST /api/prioritize/preview` only computes and stays open. Without the variable — locally — nothing changes.
The key is compared in constant time and never logged.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import secrets

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

HEADER = "x-access-key"
READ_METHODS = ("GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS")
READ_ONLY_POSTS = ("/api/prioritize/preview",)   # computes in memory, writes nothing

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["meta"])


def _required() -> str | None:
    return os.getenv("ACCESS_KEY") or None


def _valid(request: Request, key: str) -> bool:
    given = request.headers.get(HEADER)
    return given is not None and secrets.compare_digest(given.encode(), key.encode())


async def require_access_key(request: Request, call_next):
    key = _required()
    if not key or request.method in READ_METHODS or request.url.path in READ_ONLY_POSTS or _valid(request, key):
        return await call_next(request)
    return JSONResponse({"detail": "Read-only: enter the access key under Access (bottom left) to make changes."},
                        status_code=403)


@router.get("/access")
def access(request: Request) -> dict:
    """Whether changes need a key here, and whether the key this browser sends is right."""
    key = _required()
    return {"required": key is not None, "valid": key is None or _valid(request, key)}

"""Shared access key (api/access.py, D-063): off without ACCESS_KEY; with it, reads stay open and every change needs the
key in X-Access-Key (else 403, nothing written)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


@pytest.fixture
def client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from api import deps
    from api.main import app

    data = tmp_path / "data"
    (data / "models").mkdir(parents=True)
    (data / "models" / "g60.glb").write_bytes(b"glTF\x02\x00\x00\x00")
    monkeypatch.setenv("DATA_DIR", str(data))
    monkeypatch.setenv("APP_SETTINGS_FILE", str(data / "settings.json"))
    deps.DB.close()
    yield TestClient(app)
    deps.DB.close()


def test_no_key_configured_means_open(client, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.delenv("ACCESS_KEY", raising=False)
    assert client.get("/api/access").json() == {"required": False, "valid": True}
    assert client.put("/api/settings/budget", json={"ask_above_usd": 40, "stop_at_usd": 80}).status_code != 403


def test_reads_open_changes_need_the_key(client, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("ACCESS_KEY", "ankara-test")
    for path in ("/api/health", "/models/g60.glb", "/api/checkpoints", "/"):
        assert client.get(path).status_code == 200, path
    assert client.get("/api/access").json() == {"required": True, "valid": False}
    assert client.get("/api/access", headers={"X-Access-Key": "ankara-test"}).json() == {"required": True, "valid": True}

    body = {"ask_above_usd": 40, "stop_at_usd": 80}
    for headers in ({}, {"X-Access-Key": "wrong"}):
        r = client.put("/api/settings/budget", json=body, headers=headers)
        assert r.status_code == 403 and "access key" in r.json()["detail"]
    assert client.delete("/api/settings/openai-key").status_code == 403
    assert client.put("/api/settings/budget", json=body, headers={"X-Access-Key": "ankara-test"}).status_code != 403
EOF

- Date: 2026-10-13

- Context: Atahan wants anyone with the link to see the app; the repo is public. The agent pointed out that this makes

  takes the key, says whether it is accepted and can forget it; the pill only exists when the server requires a key.

  server for everyone until a restart. Tested: 4 API tests (open reads, 403 without / with a wrong key, change
  with the key), the image in Docker, the panel in the browser (read-only → key accepted → forget).

Yaptım, istediğin gibi çalışıyor:

- **Okuma herkese açık.** Sitede şifre penceresi çıkmıyor, linki olan herkes her şeyi görebiliyor.
- **Anahtarsız backend hiçbir şey değiştirmiyor.** Karar vermek, ağırlık veya ayar değiştirmek, OpenAI anahtarı girmek gibi her istek 403 ile reddediliyor. Tek istisna öncelik ağırlıklarının önizlemesi; o yalnızca hesaplıyor, hiçbir şey yazmıyor.
- **Sol altta, Guide'ın yanında Access butonu var.**
  - Panelde anahtarı girip **Unlock**'a basıyorsun, durum "Key accepted: you can make changes" oluyor.
  - Anahtar o tarayıcıda saklanıyor ve her isteğe ekleniyor; **Forget** ile siliniyor.
  - Kilitliyken buton kapalı kilit, açıkken açık kilit ikonu gösteriyor.
  - Buton yalnızca sunucu anahtar istiyorsa görünüyor, yani yerelde hiçbir şey değişmedi.
- **Anahtar `ankara31`.** Repoya yazmadım; Render'da `ACCESS_KEY` alanına sen gireceksin.

**Nasıl test ettim:**
- 4 yeni API testi eklendi: okumalar açık, anahtarsız ve yanlış anahtarla değişiklik reddediliyor, doğru anahtarla geçiyor. Toplam 136 testin hepsi geçti.
- İmajı Docker'da `ACCESS_KEY=ankara31` ile çalıştırdım ve tarayıcıda paneli denedim: önce salt okunur, anahtarla kilit açıldı, Forget ile tekrar kilitlendi.

Panel yalnızca AI agents ve Audit sayfalarında yok, çünkü o sayfalarda Dock gösterilmiyor. Diğer sayfalarda açıp kilidi kaldırınca anahtar o sayfalarda da geçerli oluyor.

Kararı D-064 olarak yazdım: BMW verisinin herkese açılması senin kararın ve uyarıyı da kayda geçirdim.

Repoda benim eklemediğim yeni dosyalar görünüyor: `.agents/`, `.claude/skills/`, `skills-lock.json`. Neon skill'leri kurulurken gelmiş olmalılar. Commit'e eklemeyeceğim.

Push edeyim mi? Render bu değişikliği ancak push'tan sonra görür. Önceki adımları beklemeden yapabilirsin: Neon'u kurup veriyi yükle; push gelince Render otomatik olarak yeniden derler.
